name: Cece
author: ure
description: A pixel-art Burmilla cat who lives on your desktop: she chases your cursor across every monitor, naps in one of four beds, plays with fifteen toys after a nap, swats a feather wand when you flick the mouse and hops to your smallest other screen while you type. A Rust port of the classic neko.

barWidget.description: Click to mute or unmute the cat, right click to make it stay put or follow, middle click to send it away or let it back out to play.

schema.label: Speed
schema.description: How fast the cat runs. 2 is the classic pace.

schema.label: Skin
schema.description: burmilla, classic, or a path to a sprite sheet PNG.

schema.label: Quiet
schema.description: No yawns, snores or startled meows.

schema.label: Nap before play
schema.description: Seconds asleep before a round of play with toys starts; 0 turns toys off.
